entities.name: Sylvene
entities.description: A Ravnican planeswalker and human mage, grandmother of Tyreus, who studied the Forgotten Realms.

entities.name: Tyreus
entities.description: Sylvene's grandson who devoted his life to magic after his parents died.

entities.name: Tyberio
entities.description: Sylvene's son, a craftsman and merchant who refused magic and forbade it to his son.

entities.name: Ayraea
entities.description: Tyberio's wife, who died of a plague with him.

entities.name: Wizard's Barrow
entities.description: Place on the High Moor where Sylvene taught and practiced magic.

entities.name: High Moor
entities.description: Region where the Wizard's Barrow stands and where Sylvene's husband died.

events.summary: Sylvene falls in love with a local man in the Realms and builds a demiplane refuge for them.
events.quote: She fell in love with a local man and built a refuge for them in a small demiplane of her creation

events.summary: Her husband dies in a misadventure on the Moor; she bears their son Tyberio in Waterdeep.
events.quote: she gave birth to their son, Tyberio, in Waterdeep

events.summary: Sylvene returns to Ravnica to raise Tyberio and dies when he is twelve.
events.quote: she passed away when Tyberio was twelve

events.summary: Tyberio and Ayraea die of a minor plague the summer Tyreus secretly begins learning magic.
events.quote: Tyberio and Ayraea passed away from a minor plague

events.summary: Tyreus devotes his life to magic.
events.quote: Tyreus devoted his life to magic thereafter.

relations.quote: She was the grandmother of Tyreus .
she gave birth to their son, Tyberio, in Waterdeep
Tyberio started a family with his wife, Ayraea
Tyberio forbade his son Tyreus from studying magic
